title: sdk: unify auth/retries, streaming parity, ergonomics improvements across Python/TS/Go + version bumps
author: Asha Kapoor
description: This PR contains coordinated changes across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to: 1) unify authentication and retry semantics; 2) bring streaming APIs into parity and improve ergonomics; 3) apply small parity fixes and bump package versions for release. Motivation: inconsistent retry behavior and auth edge cases across SDKs have caused a number of incident and developer friction reports (ENG-4512, ENG-4720). Streaming ergonomics differ by language and hurt portability of reference examples. This PR bundles changes because the behavioral contract needs to be consistent across language SDKs and the release cadence is aligned.
commits_summary: feat(python): unify auth token refresh + default retry policy; add ContextManager for streaming client
fix(ts): streaming backpressure fix, expose async iterator for chunked responses
feat(go): add unified retry middleware, harmonize auth header strategy
chore(sdk): bump versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 0.9.4, go 0.7.1
test: add cross-sdk integration tests for retry scenarios and high-latency streaming
review_comments: Miguel Alvarez: Can you clarify why we changed the default retry from 3 -> 4 attempts? Is this empirically motivated or safety margin?
Asha Kapoor: Increased to 4 to cover the transient auth refresh race we observed in internal canaries; added comment and test (integration/retries/test_token_race.py)
Priya Nair: TS change LGTM but please add a unit test for the async iterator close behavior when the connection is aborted.
Asha Kapoor: Added test and fixed iterator finalization in src/stream.ts; re-ran CI.
Tomislav Petrovic: Go linter flagged exported function docs; updated comments. Approving pending CI.
Liam Chen (CI): initial CI run failed on python linting (black) and a flaky streaming test; fixed formatting and stabilized test by mocking latency. Re-run succeeded.
release_notes:
- SDKs: unify auth header and token refresh semantics across Python/TS/Go.
- SDKs: standardized default retry policy (now 4 attempts) and clearer retryable error taxonomy.
- Python: context manager for streaming client and improved backpressure handling.
- TypeScript: async iterator streaming API for parity with Python; fixed chunking/backpressure bug.
- Go: middleware for unified retry behavior and clearer auth strategy.
- Bumped package versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 0.9.4, go 0.7.1.
- Migration docs added at docs/sdk-migration.md
